caption:
Writing three pages of feelings doesn't work through them — it rehearses them. Your brain runs the same thing on paper that it ran in your head. The difference between venting and moving through it is direction. DM "JOURNAL" for the full 7-Day Overthinking Detox. Save this for tonight.

#journaling #overthinking #journalprompts #mentalhealth #arajournals
topic: writing three pages and feeling worse
hook: you opened your journal. wrote three pages. felt worse.
